propositions: When a pytest xdist worker crashes during loadgroup distribution with thread-method timeout, the entire pending workload including the crashing test is requeued, causing the respawned worker to crash again in a cascade loop up to xdist's default restart cap of 16.
The crash-restart cascade causes single bad tests to accumulate 9+ failures and extend test runtime from 20s to 183s at -n 2 scale, pushing CI integration jobs toward the 60-minute timeout ceiling.
The loadgroup distribution mode re-dispatches crashed items (loadscope.py:166-205) while worksteal does not, making the cascade isolated to the loadgroup lane.
Setting --max-worker-restart=0 on the integration (loadgroup) lane will abort the session cleanly on worker crash instead of cascading respawns, preventing the timeout budget burn.
